[ Improved prompt ]

[ Scene and Context ]
You are to create a highly realistic and immersive image of a young woman in the midst of a vibrant night out in an Istanbul nightclub. The scene is set inside a modern club bathroom, with a young woman captured in a mirror selfie using her iPhone.

[ Subject Description ]
The woman is confident, energetic, and radiates the lively atmosphere of the club. She is in her mid to late twenties, with a curvy, feminine silhouette that moves with the rhythm of the night. Her skin is clean and free of tattoos, with a natural, slightly flushed tone from the heat and dancing. She has not overdone her makeup or appearance; instead, she exudes a fresh, natural beauty.

[ Wardrobe and Accessories ]
She is wearing a delicate lace blouse with thin spaghetti straps, designed to be tasteful yet nightclub-appropriate. The blouse features a soft, subtle dÃ©colletage that accentuates her neckline without being overly revealing. Her bottom is covered by high-waisted shorts or a fitted mini skirt that complements her silhouette. She wears a small shoulder bag that hangs naturally from one shoulder, and she has layered necklaces, bracelets, rings, and visible earrings that complete her club-ready look.

[ Pose and Composition ]
The woman is standing directly in front of a large mirror in the club bathroom, facing it head-on in a classic mirror selfie pose. She holds her iPhone at arm's length, the flash reflection and framing clearly indicating a front-camera capture, with the phone mostly out of frame. Her pose is natural and confident, with a slight turn of her body toward the mirror to showcase her profile. Her midriff is visible, but not the focus, and the sheen of sweat from dancing adds a layer of realism to her appearance.

[ Bathroom Environment ]
The bathroom is modern, with large mirrors, tiled or concrete walls, sinks, and subtle neon or warm ambient lighting that creates a dim, late-night atmosphere. The mirrors are clean but may have a slight condensation film and surface wear, adding to the realism of the scene. Signage such as EXIT or WC is placed naturally on the walls or above doors, reflecting softly in the mirrors and glossy surfaces to create depth and authenticity.

[ Photography Details ]
The image is captured using an iPhone in mirror selfie mode, with the flash turned on. The flash produces a distinct, bright, and sharp burst of iPhone-style lighting that highlights the woman's skin and the delicate lace texture of her blouse. The lens reflection is clearly visible in the mirror, indicating an iPhone front-camera capture. The aspect ratio is 9:16, typical for a mirror selfie.

[ Lighting and Color ]
The primary light source is the direct iPhone flash combined with the dim ambient lighting of the nightclub bathroom. The flash creates high-contrast highlights on the woman's skin and lace fabric, while the ambient light adds a warm, neon-infused glow to the surroundings. The lighting is designed to be realistic, with visible light bounce, soft reflections on surfaces, and a dark surround that contrasts with the bright flash. The overall color temperature favors the cool, slightly blue-toned lighting often found in nightclub settings.

[ Your Task ]
Create a single, high-resolution image that brings this scene to life with perfect clarity, authentic detail, and a strong sense of place. Use the provided details as a strict blueprint, ensuring the woman's appearance, pose, wardrobe, and accessories are rendered with absolute precision and attention to every minute detail. The image should seamlessly blend the cool, reflective surfaces of the bathroom with the warm energy of the nightclub, creating a vivid and engaging snapshot of a young woman enjoying a lively night out.
